speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin; to determine the cause, how many days old is your baby, and are there any other symptoms like poor feeding, fever, or dark urine?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Prolonged Physiological Jaundice). The history of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with weight gain and no signs of infection or hemolysis is classic for this condition. I recommend checking the Total Serum Bilirubin level to confirm the degree of hyperbilirubinemia.
